sources.title: Rational and non-rational algebraic varieties: lectures of Janos Kollar, Karen E. Smith with Joel Rosenberg
sources.location: Theorem 5.3, Remark 5.3.1, proof and Theorem 5.4; printed pp.34-37
sources.checked: Normal irreducible projective total space over the stated DVR; rational generic fiber suffices for each special component to be ruled. Proof uses normalized graph and exceptional divisors over a regular model.
sources.application: 01: projective graph compactification supplies a coefficient DVR, and reduced special fiber supplies vertical R1. No finite limiting matrix tuple is assumed.

sources.title: Beauville, Determinantal Hypersurfaces
sources.checked: Smooth cubic surfaces over an algebraically closed field admit 3x3 linear determinant equations.
sources.application: 03: smooth forms are dense; row rescaling fixes the affine scalar. The result for arbitrary cubics is closure density, not an assertion of an exact representation of each singular cubic.

sources.title: Clemens-Griffiths, The Intermediate Jacobian of the Cubic Threefold
sources.checked: Smooth complex cubic threefolds are irrational; Appendix B supplies unirationality.
sources.application: 01: together with Castelnuovo, such a threefold cannot be birational to a surface times P1.

sources.title: Colliot-Thelene-Karpenko-Merkurjev, Rational surfaces and canonical dimension of PGL6
sources.checked: A unirational integral surface over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero is rational.

sources.title: Leal-Lozano Huerta-Vite, Birational geometry of linear determinantal quartic 3-folds and rationality
sources.checked: Generic determinantal quartic threefold geometry is consistent with the incidence rationality construction.
sources.application: Corroboration; the report supplies the actual incidence argument needed over the generic DVR field.

sources.title: Codogni-Kramer, Semicontinuity of Gauss maps and the Schottky problem
sources.checked: Relative conormal flatness and effective Lagrangian specialization in characteristic zero over a smooth curve, for a smooth ambient family; not restricted to abelian varieties in this section.
sources.application: 07: projectivize in the incidence bundle; proper projection forces a conormal over each irreducible component of final reduced support.

sources.title: Landsberg-Manivel-Ressayre, Hypersurfaces with degenerate duals and the Geometric Complexity Theory Program
sources.location: Theorem 2.3.1, immediately following paragraph, section 3.1, Theorem 1.0.1
sources.checked: The degree24 flag copy for quartics has weight (65,17,2^7). Unrestricted plane choices are not identified with that single module. The determinant dual is the Segre product. The size benchmark is quadratic.
